form.label: 5G Authentication - SOC overview
form.description: Simulated 5G authentication traffic from 5g-detection-lab, with the four detection rules. The default time range is the lab hour (1 Nov 2026, 13:00-14:00 local time).

search.query: index=fiveg source="traffic.jsonl" | stats count(eval(event_type="auth_failure")) as f count as t | eval rate=round(100*f/t,1) | fields rate

panel.title: Failed logins per minute, by cause

search.query: index=fiveg source="traffic.jsonl" event_type=auth_failure | timechart span=1m count by cause

panel.title: Rule 1 - Fake base station (MAC_FAILURE): 5+ different subscribers in one cell within 5 min

search.query: index=fiveg source="traffic.jsonl" event_type=auth_failure cause=MAC_FAILURE | bin _time span=5m | stats count dc(subscriber) as subscribers by _time cell | where subscribers >= 5

panel.title: Rule 2 - SUCI flood (SUCI_INVALID): 10+ per cell per minute

search.query: index=fiveg source="traffic.jsonl" event_type=auth_failure cause=SUCI_INVALID | bin _time span=1m | stats count by _time cell | where count >= 10

panel.title: Rule 3 - Rogue serving network (RES_MISMATCH): 3+ subscribers through one network within 10 min

search.query: index=fiveg source="traffic.jsonl" event_type=auth_failure cause=RES_MISMATCH | bin _time span=10m | stats count dc(subscriber) as subscribers values(cell) as cells by _time serving_network | where subscribers >= 3

panel.title: Rule 4 - Replay / linkability (SYNCH_FAILURE): 3+ failures for one subscriber within 10 min

search.query: index=fiveg source="traffic.jsonl" event_type=auth_failure cause=SYNCH_FAILURE | bin _time span=10m | stats count values(cell) as cells by _time subscriber | where count >= 3
